channels.name: Synchronous serial link (NRZI)
channels.purpose: Single bit-synchronous serial channel carrying NRZI-encoded bit stream with bit stuffing for transparency and clock-recovery transition guarantee.
channels.physical_realization: Typical: V.24/RS-232 (low-speed), V.35 (medium-speed), V.36/V.10/V.11 differential, E1/T1 carrier (DS0 or full E1 framing). Spec leaves PHY unspecified.

channels.name: Asynchronous serial link (RS-232 style)
channels.purpose: Single asynchronous octet stream carrying NRZ-encoded bytes with octet stuffing for control-octet transparency.
channels.physical_realization: Typical: RS-232 (V.24/V.28); used by PPP-async, V.42 LAPM, and HDLC over modem dial-up.

channels.name: Multidrop bus (SDLC)
channels.purpose: Single shared synchronous link with one primary terminal and N secondaries, addressed by Address field.
channels.physical_realization: Typical: RS-485 or current-loop multidrop in IBM SNA deployments.

logical_signal_states.name: Flag
logical_signal_states.rule: Opens and closes every frame; never appears within frame body (synchronous: bit stuffing prevents it; asynchronous: octet stuffing prevents it).

logical_signal_states.name: Idle line
logical_signal_states.rule: Receiver remains in FLAG_HUNT until next opening flag.

logical_signal_states.name: Abort sequence
logical_signal_states.rule: Forces receiver to discard in-progress frame and return to FLAG_HUNT.

logical_signal_states.name: Escape octet (async)
logical_signal_states.rule: Asynchronous control-octet transparency; following octet is XOR'd with 0x20.

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: CONTROL
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 8 or 16 bits; encodes I/S/U + N(S)/N(R) + P/F + M-bits

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: INFORMATION
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: Variable, 8*N bits; present in I, UI, UIH, XID, TEST, SM, FRMR

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: FCS
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 16 or 32 bits; CRC-CCITT default, CRC-32 optional

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: FLAG
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 8 bits = 0x7E; MAY be shared with next opening flag

dependency_graph.common_rule: Single serial channel: sender drives one bit at a time; receiver de-stuffs and decodes; frame boundary is the 0x7E flag.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: FCS depends on (Address + Control + Information). Bit stuffing depends on (last 5 transmitted bits being all 1). N(S) depends on local transmit counter. N(R) depends on local receive counter.
dependency_graph.ack_dependency: Acknowledgement of I-frame N(S)=k delivered via peer's later N(R)=k+1 (mod-8/128) piggybacked on any I or S frame.

handshake_pairs.name: MODE_SET
handshake_pairs.rule: SNRM/SARM/SABM (+E variants) command → UA response (accept) or DM/FRMR (reject).

handshake_pairs.name: PIGGYBACK_ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: N(R) field of any I or S frame acknowledges all I-frames with N(S) < N(R) (mod-8/128).

handshake_pairs.name: POLL_FINAL_TOKEN
handshake_pairs.rule: P-bit set in command solicits response; F-bit set in response signals end-of-response; only one token in flight.

handshake_pairs.name: GO_BACK_N_RETRANS
handshake_pairs.rule: REJ N(R)=k requests retransmission of N(S)=k and all subsequent.

handshake_pairs.name: SELECTIVE_RETRANS
handshake_pairs.rule: SREJ N(R)=k requests retransmission of ONLY N(S)=k; optional.

handshake_pairs.name: FLOW_CONTROL_STOP
handshake_pairs.rule: RNR pauses transmitter; cleared by next RR.

handshake_pairs.name: DISCONNECT
handshake_pairs.rule: DISC command → UA response; both enter DM.

ordering_rules.within_a_byte: Least-significant bit transmitted first within each octet.
ordering_rules.frame_field_order: Flag → Address → Control → Information → FCS → Flag.
ordering_rules.global_ordering: Frames serialised on the wire; N(S) gives application-level ordering within a station's transmit stream; receiver delivers in N(S) order (go-back-N) or holds out-of-order (selective reject buffer).
